rules.statement: A HazardousEvent is the composition of a hazard and an operating situation.
S/E/C evidence and the controlled ASIL lookup must be retained with the decision.
The bundled executable gate covers the source-grounded S2/E4/C3 -> ASIL C cell; the full controlled table remains a declared gap.

additional_source_grounded_data.coverage: representative subset copied from the bundled demo; not the complete controlled 36-row table

limitations: Only the declared SHACL and SPARQL behavior is executable.
No package may be treated as a product release verdict.
